_comment: Każdy wpis w 'leads' odpowiada jednej kategorii dowodu forensycznego (musi zgadzać się z 'field' w gameState.currentMission.forensicHardEvidence). {{value}} jest podstawiane realną wartością z requiredForensicProfile przez CSIDialogBuilder.js. 'redHerrings' to dowody, które NIC nie wnoszą - do wywołania niezależnie od realnego dowodu.

hair_color.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: Forensics here. We just finished sweeping the crime scene.
We found something. A single {{value}} hair near the display case.
It's not much, but it should narrow down your list of suspects.

shoe_size_category.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: There's a partial shoe print near the window. Size {{value}}, rubber sole.
Whoever it was, they came in through there.

earring_fragment.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: We found an earring fragment under the display case. {{value}}, not the museum's style.
Someone lost it in a hurry.

stage_1.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: One more thing before I go.
There's a fiber sample from the scene too, but it's too generic to trace to anyone specific.

stage_1.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: Also logged a coin found near the entrance.
Common currency, no markings. Probably not worth chasing.

stage_2.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: Second pass on the evidence is done.
That fiber you flagged? Dead end. Doesn't match anyone on your list.

stage_2.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: The coin you found is just loose change. Nothing traceable.

callOnlyIntro.speaker: CSI Analyst
lines: This is forensics. You're new, so I'll walk you through it over the phone instead of dragging you down here.
Once you make Field Agent, you'll get the full lab tour. For now, here's what we've got.
